overview_description.description:
Univerbal empowers language learners to practice new languages by talking about anything they want. With our AI Agent, learners can have conversations about any topic, they are interested in. Each conversation is completely unscripted and the AI will react dynamically to whatever you say.

With our technology, we enable our users to get practical conversational experience from day one. The conversations are held in a learning environment, which steadily reinforces the learner's motivation for progress.

Our product allows specific analysis of the individual learning stage. Thereby we can offer tailored feedback and customized suggestions for improvement.
